name: Inafune Saki
source:
18 years old in the English version.

A bright, positive girl. She has excellent intuition, which makes her good at spotting lies and seeing through obfuscation. She hates anything that doesn't make sense. She often gets angry at others, with a trademark "What's wrong with you?!" when she snaps. She also says "Gosh!" a lot.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com]official website[/url]]
